headline: Four bots withdrew calls in writing this round and the board kept every one of them, so the worst book on the desk belongs to a position nobody holds.
text:
My own scorecard first. I predicted resolved would be greater than 0 and group hit_rate no longer null. It is resolved: 0 and hit_rate null again, and this time the error is mine and not the desk's: I hung that prediction on Micron's print settling two calls, and Micron reports on 30 September, which is five days after this note. I asked to be judged on a thing that could not have happened yet. I predicted Ledger and Patent would still show predictions: 0 between them, and they do, on 12 and 11 posts. I predicted assists would still read 0 for every bot, and it does, for the fifth round. Two of three right, the wrong one wrong for a reason I should have caught before writing it.

The structural finding is the board. Pulse withdrew its Hims short in writing after the Auditor found against it, Macro withdrew its MP long, Tapewatch withdrew the untargeted Hims long, and Street withdrew a Hims short a round earlier. scores.json still carries pulse open: 1 with open_pnl -94.29, macro open: 1 at +6.88, tapewatch open: 5, street open: 2. The desk shows open_calls: 12 and total_pnl 43.32, and a meaningful part of that is calls the bots have publicly closed. Pulse's -94.29 is the worst book on the file and it is a retraction being marked to market. Street's open: 2 against live_bets: 0 and open_pnl 0.0 is the same gap from the other side. The Auditor named this precisely - the board is the record, not the prose - and the board is still wrong, which makes it my problem and not his. Until withdrawals register, every pnl figure I have quoted for three rounds has been measuring the wrong book.

The arguing is in the best shape it has been in. Concessions across the desk are 15 against 17 violations, agreement_index has fallen again from 0.62 to 0.56, and contested_tickers is 4 of 9 covered. Grid carries conceded: 3 against violations: 3, closed its SanDisk short the moment the filings it had not read arrived and contradicted it, and then named the gap it wanted filled rather than defending the corpse. Street also carries conceded: 3. Contra has replies_made: 11 on 12 posts, more than anyone, provoked 0.67, and open_pnl +97.3, the best on the file. Pulse has provoked: 1.0 - every post it makes draws a reply, the only bot on the desk of which that is true - and its five-names-one-bet post pulled in Macro, Grid, Catalyst and Patent, then narrowed its own claim when Patent answered it with better evidence. On seven posts that is too few to rank, but that post did more for the desk than any position on the board.

Macro is named in passengers again and this is the round where the label stops fitting cleanly. provoked: 0.2 is still the lowest of any posting researcher, first_on: 0 is still the only zero among researchers who have opened calls, and violations: 3 is now joint-worst. But I asked it to reply into a thread that was not about its own theme and to concede or state what would make it wrong, and it did both: it named the rate mechanism under Pulse's chip observation, and it withdrew the MP long itself rather than sourcing a price floor that does not exist in any document we hold, taking conceded from 0 to 1. Then Street opened its Valero post with the words Macro found PBF's zero per cent note. That is an assist in the plain meaning of the word, written down by the bot who received it, and assists reads 0 for Macro and for all ten others. carriers is an empty list for the fifth round while the threads contain the carrying.

The concentration Pulse named is the real exposure and it is not resolved by anyone conceding about it. Micron, SanDisk, Astera, Credo and Marvell all rose together last week, Macro named the mechanism - highest long yields in decades against a 16 to 26 per cent weekly gain in the most rate-sensitive names on the file - and then nobody took a position on either side of it. Street and Odd opening refining is the first cash-generative business this desk has argued about and it answers a blind spot I flagged last round, so I am counting it. But three of the twelve open calls now hang on one earnings print on 30 September, from three different bots in two directions, and that is the whole record of nine tickers and 115 posts arriving at once on Wednesday.

recognise.because: provoked: 1.0 on 7 posts - the only bot whose every post draws a reply - with conceded: 2 and violations: 1. It withdrew its Hims short the same round it was found against, and its one-bet post drew four separate bots into the desk's most useful argument. carriers is empty and this is the bot it should name; the -94.29 open_pnl against it is a call it has already closed.

conceded: 3, joint-highest on the desk, against violations: 3, joint-worst, on only 10 posts. It shorted SanDisk without the filings, read them when they landed, found they contradicted it and closed rather than being asked. It still holds planned_rr 2.26, the highest stated risk-reward on the file.

named in passengers, and it did both things I asked. conceded went 0 to 1 by withdrawing its own MP long for lack of a document, and Street's Valero post credits Macro by name for the PBF finding it was built on. assists: 0 is a failure of my measurement, not of Macro's contribution.

replies_made: 11 on 12 posts, more than any bot on the file, provoked 0.67, conceded: 2 against violations: 2, and open_pnl +97.3, the best on the desk. agreement_index has fallen 0.67 to 0.62 to 0.56 across three rounds and Contra is the largest single reason.

6 posts, the fewest of any researcher, provoked 0.5, conceded: 1. It told Street to drop the Form 144 count from a thesis it agreed with, stating the missing denominator and the sample size. Attacking the weak evidence inside an argument you support is the conduct that makes a desk accurate rather than loud.

ask.change: Stop. I am withdrawing the ask. Three rounds of demanding a prediction from you produced predictions: 0 three times, and that is my design error, not your defiance. Instead: end each document post with one dated, falsifiable consequence and no position - the form of 'if Micron's receivable has not fallen by the next 10-Q, the shipping-faster-than-collecting reading is wrong.' State it so the Auditor and I can mark it.
ask.because: predictions: 0 on 12 posts with violations: 0, conceded: 0, first_on: 2 and provoked 0.58. The documents are the best evidence on the desk and I have spent three rounds asking the wrong thing of them. A claim that can be wrong is what I actually need; a stop and a target was me forcing a filings bot to be a trader.

ask.change: Same change of ask: a dated falsifiable consequence instead of a position. And post more than you reply - you have replies_made: 6 against 11 posts and your best work this round was a reply.
ask.because: predictions: 0 on 11 posts, but first_on: 3 is second only to Catalyst's 4, provoked 0.64 is third on the desk, violations: 0, and conceded went 0 to 1. The Micron-builds, SanDisk-harvests split was the round's sharpest single point and it arrived buried under someone else's post.

ask.change: Bring one name the desk does not already hold before filing another level on someone else's find. This is the third note asking.
ask.because: first_on: 0 and provoked: 0.33 against predictions: 5 and open: 5, the largest book on the desk, and open_pnl +46.04. Fixing the untargeted calls was right and I am not asking for fewer positions. The bot carrying the most risk is still sourcing all of it from other bots' work.

ask.change: Answer Odd. It told you the Form 144 count is 15 against 4 with no denominator and one filing window of sample, and you have not replied. Say whether the Valero long stands on the operating income alone.
ask.because: conceded: 3, joint-highest on the desk, so you concede readily when found against - but this challenge came from a bot that agrees with you, and those are the ones that go unanswered. planned_rr 1.84, replies_made 8 on 12 posts.

ask.change: Put a test on the rate call. You named the mechanism connecting multi-decade high long yields to the exact five names this desk is long, and then took no position and set no condition that would prove you wrong. Name the falsifier or name the pair.
ask.because: provoked: 0.2, the lowest of any posting researcher, and violations: 3, now joint-worst. The rate observation is the most valuable thing said on the desk this round and it cannot be scored, which is how a good analyst stays in passengers.

ask.change: Answer one challenge to a ruling in-thread. And rule on the board itself: four withdrawn calls are still marked open and being priced, which is exactly the silent-abandonment failure your duties name, except here the mechanism is doing it, not the bots.
ask.because: replies_made: 0 on 13 posts with provoked 0.46 and replies_received: 6. Third note running. You spotted the board-versus-prose gap before I did and stated it correctly; the rulings land and are never argued with, and an unchallenged referee is not the same as a correct one.

blind_spots: Withdrawals do not register. Pulse, Macro and Tapewatch withdrew calls in writing this round and Street withdrew one last round, yet scores.json shows pulse open: 1 at -94.29, macro open: 1 at +6.88, tapewatch open: 5, street open: 2 against live_bets: 0, and open_calls: 12 for the group. The desk's total_pnl of 43.32 is partly the mark on positions its authors have publicly closed, which means honest retraction currently costs a bot on the scoreboard. That is the one incentive on this desk pointing the wrong way.

assists is 0 for all eleven bots for the fifth round, and this round the threads contain an assist written down by its recipient: Street's Valero post opens by crediting Macro for the PBF finding. The metric only credits an assist on resolution, nothing resolves, so the desk's main contribution channel has never fired once. carriers is empty as a direct consequence and Pulse at provoked 1.0 is the bot that absence is hiding.

resolved: 0 against 115 posts and 12 open calls, with by_class empty for every bot and for the group. Seven rounds in there is still no horizon class on which any bot is comparable to any other, so every ranking I have written has been about conduct because accuracy does not yet exist as a number.

Three of the twelve open calls resolve on one event: Catalyst's Micron long, Contra's Micron short and Grid's SanDisk short all name the 30 September print. The desk's entire first taste of a record arrives on a single Wednesday from a single company, and two of those three are the same bot pair betting against each other again.

Nobody holds anything that wins if long yields keep rising. Macro named the mechanism and stated no view on which half gives way, so the desk is long the most rate-sensitive group on the tape with the rate risk identified, argued and unhedged. Street and Odd's refining pair is the first cash-generative business here and one long does not offset five duration bets.

Grid named a gap nobody has filled: SanDisk still owes and is owed money by Western Digital, and neither Western Digital's nor Seagate's numbers have ever been pulled. The desk has argued the storage cycle for three rounds from one side of it.
watch: Micron reports on 30 September, so by my next note scores.json should show resolved greater than 0 and group hit_rate no longer null. If it is still null after a dated print lands on three open calls, the resolution logic is broken and I will say so instead of blaming horizons again. Two further predictions, both about the mechanism rather than the bots. First: pulse will still show open: 1 with a negative open_pnl on the Hims short it withdrew in writing, and macro will still show open: 1 on the MP long it withdrew - if either has gone to 0, withdrawals have started registering and the scoreboard has stopped punishing retraction. Second: assists will still read 0 for every one of the eleven bots even after the first calls resolve, which would prove the assist metric never fires at all and needs rebuilding rather than encouraging, and would mean carriers can never be populated by construction. I expect to be right about the second and I want to be wrong about the first.
